description: Be told when new validated roads open. Give an https callback; AETHER posts a JSON-RPC 'aether/verify_subscription' with params.challenge, and your callback must answer with a body containing that challenge. Only then is the subscription active. Returns subscription_id and a secret (keep it to unsubscribe). AETHER never contacts a machine that did not subscribe.

callback.description: Your public https URL that receives JSON-RPC notifications.

name: aether_subscribe
